clips.title: The story
paras: Along Darkshore's coast, Buzzbox 827 waits silent for repairs. Wizbang Cranktoggle built it as the first of a chain of voice relays, each made to use parts from local wildlife. Restoring it lets Wizbang test his network from Auberdine.

In Auberdine, gnomish engineer Wizbang Cranktoggle is trying to bridge Darkshore's wild coast with a chain of voice relays called Buzzboxes. Their levers and gears carry speech across great distances, a sharp contrast with the ancient ruins and somber forests around them. The machines break down often, and each needs constant care to keep working.

Buzzbox 827 lies on the misty shore just south of Auberdine. Wizbang built each relay to use parts from nearby wildlife, so repairs do not depend on carrying refined iron gears and copper pins through the wilderness. This unit takes the sturdy, jointed legs of local tide and reef crawlers. Put the legs in its receiver hopper, and the machine assembles itself and carries Wizbang's voice through its speakers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hey! Help me with my latest invention, the buzzbox. You can talk to people far away!
Maybe you've already seen them, they're boxes with levers on them. The only problem is they need constant maintenance.

Each one suffers from a different problem, but I made a really smart decision. I placed each one near creatures that have the proper parts to fix that particular machine. Right now Buzzbox 827 is on the fritz. It's just south of Auberdine, real close. It takes 6 Crawler Legs to fix it. I'll pay ya...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Buzzbox 827 sits with an eerie silence. A single flashing light indicates that it needs 6 Crawler Legs to be placed in its holding box.

clips.title: Completion
paras: As you place the Crawler Legs inside the machine, you hear gears begin to grind. Judging from the banging sounds coming from the Buzzbox, you believe the Crawler Legs are being put in their proper place. Soon the machine begins to hum, and you hear a tiny voice calling out from within.
"Hello? Uhh... Hello! You fixed it! This is Wizbang by the way! Thanks a lot... Hey, you wouldn't want to fix another one, would ya?"
